bugs.title: Collapsed workspace cards use generic repeated copy
bugs.symptom: Different modules can look complete but expose nearly identical summary text, hiding module-specific workflow, entity and handoff context.
bugs.root_cause: The shared summary renderer used six hard-coded generic cards instead of deriving content from each module specification.
bugs.fix: Generate six validated cards from each ModuleExperienceSpec and attach stable diagnostic metadata.

bugs.title: Long module metadata can crowd narrow cards
bugs.symptom: Long entity, workflow or handoff text may force uneven card sizing on narrow windows.
bugs.root_cause: Cards lacked explicit min-width, height and white-space safeguards.
bugs.fix: Add min-width:0, full-height alignment, controlled overflow and normal wrapping.

verification.selected_tests: 65 passed, 0 failed across two completed runs
